promotionGate: execute only after S3 independent R3 ACCEPT and acceptance receipt commit

redSeal.cause: tools.news_grasp_cleanroom_recovery absent at three dynamic imports
redSeal.coverage: 8 review blockers, 6 crash phases, 23 persisted mutations, 8 authority failures, 3 legacy cases

writeLease.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',',':'); SHA-256

publicContract.audit: audit(issue_date, parent, authority, budget, observed_at) -> RECOVERY_RECONCILE_RESULT_V1
publicContract.inspect: inspect(issue_date) -> RECOVERY_INSPECTION_V1 and performs no child call or state mutation
publicContract.legacy: LegacyReadOnlyAdapter(path) public callable method surface is exactly read

exactLedgerContract.binding: exact RECOVERY_BINDING_V1 with issueDate,parentSha256,authoritySha256,budgetSha256,recoveryId; recoveryId is canonical SHA-256 of issueDate+parentSha256+authoritySha256 and is independent of runtime path
exactLedgerContract.recordSeal: canonical SHA-256 of the exact 16 column-name/value mapping excluding record_sha256
exactLedgerContract.jsonRule: all JSON columns are UTF-8 canonical JSON; parse, exact-key/type/semantic validate, canonical round-trip and bound hash validate on every inspect/audit before replay
exactLedgerContract.corruption: missing/extra binding, unknown phase, attempts other than integer exactly 1, ID/hash drift, malformed or rebound child receipt, history/result mismatch, or record seal mismatch is RECOVERY_LEDGER_CORRUPT with zero child calls and zero repair

order: validate exact RECOVERY_PARENT_V1 and parentSha256; extra route key is RECOVERY_ROUTE_UNKNOWN
read S1 control ledger without write/create/checkpoint and validate exact Scheduled parent plus current Audit owner/fence
validate exact RECOVERY_AUTHORITY_V1/authoritySha256 and exact RECOVERY_BUDGET_V1/budgetSha256
load and fully validate an existing recovery record before comparing current authority; different valid authority against an existing issueDate is RECOVERY_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT
only a valid new authority/budget with no record may insert ATTEMPT_DURABLE
validationDesign.s1ReadOnly: never modify control-ledger-v1.sqlite3, its WAL/SHM, single-entry JSON WAL, manifest or any non-S4 file; use an actual read-only SQLite path and close before returning

phaseMachine: insert one ATTEMPT_DURABLE row with attempts_used=1 and empty receipts/history/result, seal and commit; invoke before_execution_receipt

call execution once with exact RECOVERY_CHILD_REQUEST_V1, validate exact EXECUTION_RECONCILE_RESULT_V1, store canonical receipt/hash and phase EXECUTION_RESULT_DURABLE atomically; invoke after_execution_receipt
advance and seal EXECUTION_COMMITTED; invoke before_public_receipt

call public once with the same bound recovery request plus execution receipt binding, validate exact PUBLIC_RECONCILE_RESULT_V1, store receipt/hash and phase PUBLIC_RESULT_DURABLE; invoke after_public_receipt
advance and seal PUBLIC_COMMITTED, build one Recovery history event and final result, store history/result/hashes with phase RESULT_DURABLE; invoke before_recovery_commit
advance and seal COMMITTED; invoke after_recovery_commit; return the stored result
each retry reopens SQLite, validates the entire record and resumes from its phase; a durable receipt/result is never reconstructed from module memory and a completed child is never called again

receiptAndResultContract.childRequest: exact RECOVERY_CHILD_REQUEST_V1 with issueDate,recoveryId,parentSha256,authoritySha256,budgetSha256,attemptNumber=1 and priorReceipt binding where applicable
receiptAndResultContract.history: canonical non-empty list ending in one exact Recovery lineage event bound to recoveryId and both receipt hashes
receiptAndResultContract.result: exact RECOVERY_RECONCILE_RESULT_V1 with issueDate,recoveryId,status=CONFIRMED,attemptsUsed=1,execution,public,recoveryHistory,legacy,legacyWriterCount=0; terminal retry returns byte-equivalent stored dict

legacyContract.valid: exact LEGACY_RECOVERY_V3 object with issueDate,status,payloadSha256; payload hash excludes payloadSha256; return snapshot plus raw bytesSha256 without changing bytes or mtime
legacyContract.invalid: malformed/hash mismatch is LEGACY_STATE_INVALID; unknown schema is LEGACY_STATE_UNKNOWN; both before child or recovery-ledger mutation
legacyContract.api: read only; no write/append/replace/update/delete method; legacyWriterCount is always 0

forbiddenImplementation: write/open S1 ledger in mutable mode
test edit or test-specific mutation branch

other: pre-stage status exactly one lease path
